name: Cable Car
description: Cable car most commonly refers to the following cable transportation systems:Aerial lift, such as aerial tramways and gondola lifts, in which the vehicle is suspended in the air from a cable Aerial tramway Chairlift Gondola lift Bicable gondola lift Tricable gondola lift Cable railway, in which the vehicle rests on rails or a road. Cable car (railway), a type of cable transportation used for mass transit Funicular, a type of cable transportation on a slope, which is referred to in Japan as "cable car"
